isitdown.label.url: The address that is not working
isitdown.status.idle: It measures your site and three always-up sites at the same time
isitdown.status.badUrl: That does not look like an address. e.g. example.com
isitdown.verdict.up: {host} answers right now. it is up
isitdown.verdict.mine: Looks like your side. the control sites fail too (internet, Wi-Fi, DNS)
isitdown.verdict.theirs: Only {host} fails. looks like their side
isitdown.verdict.unclear: Cannot tell. the controls disagree. Try again in a moment
isitdown.note.limits: A browser cannot read a cross-origin response (it is opaque). "answers" here means the server is reachable, not that the service is healthy. A broken login page still looks up
